title: ZMeta adapter-harness fixture line
description: Schema for one JSONL fixture line consumed by tools/validate_adapter_conformance.py. The harness lints every fixture line against this schema before execution, so an unknown expectation key is a caught typo, not a silent no-op; tools/check_adapter.py runs the same lint at author time. The harness remains the behavioral authority.

expect.description: result 'events' requires an event_count pin: without one, a refusing adapter returning [] satisfies every top-level expectation vacuously.

name.description: Fixture label used in harness output (defaults to line-<n>).

module.description: Repository-relative path to the adapter module to load.

callable.description: Function name to call on the loaded module.

args.description: Positional arguments passed to the callable.

kwargs.description: Keyword arguments passed to the callable.

result.description: Whether the callable returns one event dict (default) or a list of event dicts.

profile.description: Validation profile for schema/policy checks (default H).

events.description: For result 'events', per-index expectations go inside the events list; sibling keys next to 'events' are silently ignored by the harness, so the lint forbids them. event_count is the exception: it is a result-level pin the harness checks before per-index dispatch, and it is REQUIRED alongside 'events' so per-index expectations beyond the returned event count cannot be silently skipped (the harness fails such fixtures too).

event_count.description: Exact number of events the callable must return. Required alongside expect.events; also the refusal register for BOTH result kinds: 0 pins a fail-closed refusal the way other expectations pin emission - result "events" callables must return [], and result "event" (single-event) callables register refusal by returning None, which the harness counts as zero events. A single-event fixture without event_count implicitly expects exactly one event.

events.description: For result "events": per-index expectation objects. Items are leaf expectations - a nested 'events' inside an item is silently ignored by the harness, so the lint forbids it.

required_paths.description: Dotted paths that must resolve on the output event.

forbidden_paths.description: Dotted paths that must NOT resolve on the output event.

expected_values.description: Dotted path -> exact value pins. Numeric tolerance 1e-6; booleans never match non-booleans; a missing path is its own failure.

utc_z_paths.description: Paths that must be UTC timestamps with trailing Z (default ["event.ts"]).

require_lineage_transform.description: Default true for non-SYSTEM events; set false for original observations that legitimately omit lineage.

allow_degraded_timing.description: Default false: an UNSYNCED timing fallback fails unless explicitly allowed.

external_promotion_required_keys.description: Keys that must be present inside external_promotion.
